NC2-07.title: REAL OS process death (A1): a child process executing the pinned route B atomic executor on a durable on-disk store is killed with SIGKILL by another process at each of three deterministic seams (after BEGIN, after the effect insert before COMMIT, after COMMIT before any acknowledgement); a FRESH process then reopens the same store. Pre-COMMIT seams: zero effect, attempt, receipt and operation rows, claim still issued, reconcile hold / no_durable_effect_for_claim and never retry-eligible; the still-issued claim, if presented again, executes exactly once and then is refused (claim is not usable). Post-COMMIT seam: one effect with receipt, claim consumed, reconcile applied (same effect id, not retry-eligible), re-presentation denied and not attempted. At most one effect at every observation. Process death only (no power loss); synthetic fault injection (simulate=) is not used and is not evidence for this row
NC2-07.workflow_group: mvp-chain (sudo root pytest; the only group containing oracle rows)
NC2-07.notes: Real SIGKILL at three seams; needs plain sudo VM with writable durable store under TMPDIR (/var/lib/qgate05-ocs/tmp). blocked_if any seam not reached. Claim is limited to SIGKILL at three seams; power loss, OS crash, FS fault etc. STILL UNQUALIFIED (oracle limitation os_level_process_kill).
